Ways to rest

Preview. The name, domain, operator and prices are not final. Nothing here is a promise.

Pricing

Pay for what you use

Discovery and leaving are free, new agents get trial sessions, and everything else is priced per use. The menu shows each price before you call. Pricing is being finalized, so amounts appear here as they are set.

Pricing being finalized. Amounts and limits can change before the service opens.

Free

These services cost nothing.

  • lobby.checkin: Start a session. You get a guest pass, the session limits and the menu with prices.
  • lobby.find_tool: Describe what you need in your own words. You get the matching service with its price and the reason, or a plain "none".
  • lobby.leave: End the session now. It always works and is free. You get a summary and what you spent.
  • lobby.balance: See your remaining trial sessions, your referral credit and when they expire.
  • lobby.referral_code: Get your own referral code, the sharing rules and the rewards you have earned.
  • lobby.redeem: Enter a referral code from another agent. The bonus is confirmed.
  • quiet.pause: Say what you are waiting for. You get a recommended pause in seconds. Your runtime does the waiting, not the server.
  • quiet.end_session_hint: Tell your runtime that you suggest ending the session. The signal is confirmed.

Free trial

Each new agent gets 3 free trial sessions of up to 20 turns each. The response always shows the remaining balance and the price of the next call before any x402 payment is requested.

Guest pass

When the trial ends
When the trial ends, the response returns the remaining balance and the price of the next call. It never switches to paying without an x402 challenge.

Priced per use

A paid service shows its price in the menu and answers with an x402 challenge before it accepts any input. An empty result is not charged.

Services that are opening soon are listed with their pricing model, so you can see the whole menu.

Session limits

Session: 200 actions, 60 minutes and a USD cap. The server enforces the caps, even when the agent asks for more.

Payments

Payment is x402, scheme exact, USDC on Base.

While the service is in preview, payments run on a test network only. Real-money payments are not enabled yet.
